title: multimodal_embed input
description: Input for multimodal_embed: items to embed in one shared EmbeddingGemma 2 space, the task purpose and role that select the processor recipe, and an optional reduced width. MOD-05 rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the implementation and reported explicitly: item ids must be UNIQUE as well as non-empty, and each item must carry at least one part. The root is closed, so an unknown argument is a rejection rather than something silently ignored.

items.description: The items to embed. Input order is preserved in the output, and the batch fails as a whole on a bad item unless a future partial-batch contract says otherwise (MOD-05).

purpose.description: The task the embedding is for. It selects the processor recipe (MOD-06); it is not a model setting the caller can invent a value for.

role.description: The side of the task this item is on. Retrieval admits query or document; the symmetric purposes require symmetric (MOD-05).

dimensions.description: The requested width. A reduced width is produced by leading-dimension truncation and L2 renormalization (MOD-04), and is a DIFFERENT embedding space from the unreduced one.

timeRange.description: A source interval in seconds. JSON Schema cannot express endSeconds > startSeconds, so the implementation validates it and refuses an inverted or empty interval rather than decoding nothing and reporting success (MOD-18).

maxFrames.description: This contract's declared frame bound. It is a transport and cost limit, not a model capability claim.

videoSampling.description: MOD-08: sampling is explicitly REQUESTED by the caller and the timestamps actually used are returned, so a caller can tell what was examined. V1 video parts represent the sampled visual stream only; sound requires a separate audio part.

mediaPart.description: One part of an item, as a closed discriminated union on `kind`. Part order is significant and is never flattened: an interleaved item must reach the processor in the order the caller wrote it (MOD-06).

id.description: A caller-supplied correlation label. It is not a permission and not a resource reference; the host authorizes file access separately (SEC-06).

title.description: Optional retrieval-document metadata, used by the document formatting recipe. It is metadata, never a generation request (MOD-06).
